bundle.shortDescription: TTOBAK — record desktop meetings with system audio and microphone
bundle.longDescription: TTOBAK Mac App records desktop meetings (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet) by capturing system audio with a Core Audio process tap mixed with the microphone, and uploads recordings to the TTOBAK meeting workspace.
